verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents ways to get data out: the App API can fetch data, data-out integrations send data to external platforms such as analytics tools and CRMs, and the CLI and MCP server give agents read access to workspace data. However, nothing in the pack describes a complete, self-serve export of all workspace data in open formats, so leaving would mean assembling an export from APIs and integrations. Missing for 10: a documented full-workspace export, explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), export coverage of all data types (profiles, events, messages, automations), and independent or hands-on confirmation of migrating out.
